architecture: three modality tokens per word, 2-layer 8-head cross-modal Transformer, 2-layer temporal Transformer, hidden=128, dropout=0.2
loss: frequency weighted CE power=0.5, label_smoothing=0.03, 0.6 SmoothL1, supervised_contrastive=0.05, distillation_weight=0.2
optimizer: AdamW lr=0.00015, weight_decay=1e-3, batch=64, clip=1, patience=7
augmentation: 35% clean, 30% contiguous modality subsets, 35% scattered shared TAV gaps
selection: full valid clean + contiguous + scattered profile from the predeclared q2 score
data_policy: safe train/valid only; full test and attachment-3 labels are never loaded
